name: Amaziah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Joash also did evil and departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, and he fought against Amaziah king of Judah.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

points: Amaziah sent to Jehoash king of Israel to face one another in battle, and Jehoash answered with the parable of the thistle and the cedar, warning him to stay home lest he fall.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: Amaziah would not hear, so the two faced one another at Bethshemesh, and Judah was put to the worse before Israel and fled.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: Amaziah lived fifteen years after the death of Jehoash, and a conspiracy was made against him in Jerusalem so that he fled to Lachish and was slain there.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: The people took Azariah, sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: Azariah, also called Uzziah, begins to reign over Judah and does that which is right in the sight of the Most High as his father Amaziah had done.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: Amaziah his son reigned in his stead; the fuller record of Joash is written in the story of the book of the kings.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 24: Joash Repairs the House and Then Falls

points: Amaziah began to reign at twenty and five years old and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. He did that which was right in the sight of the Most High, but not with a perfect heart. As soon as the kingdom was established he slew the servants that had killed his father the king.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 25: Amaziah Serves the Most High With a Divided Heart

points: Amaziah gathered Judah and Benjamin, numbered them from twenty years old and upward, and found three hundred thousand choice men able to go to war. He also hired a hundred thousand mighty men out of Israel for a hundred talents of silver.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 25: Amaziah Serves the Most High With a Divided Heart

points: When Amaziah asked what to do about the hundred talents he had already paid, the prophet told him the Most High is able to give him much more than that. Amaziah obeyed, separated the army of Ephraim to go home, and they went home in great anger.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 25: Amaziah Serves the Most High With a Divided Heart

points: Amaziah strengthened himself, led his people to the valley of salt, and smote ten thousand of the children of Seir, and cast down another ten thousand from the top of the rock. But he brought back the gods of the children of Seir, set them up to be his own gods, bowed to them, and burned incense to them.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 25: Amaziah Serves the Most High With a Divided Heart

points: The Most High sent a prophet who asked why he sought after gods that could not even deliver their own people out of his hand. This is why counsel is important. The prophet was trying to counsel Amaziah to destroy the idols, and instead Amaziah threatened him and told him to forbear, be quiet. The prophet forbore, but said the Most High had determined to destroy him because he had done this and had not hearkened to counsel.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 25: Amaziah Serves the Most High With a Divided Heart

points: Amaziah took advice and sent to Joash king of Israel saying, Come, let us see one another in the face. Joash answered with a parable of the thistle and the cedar, telling him his heart lifted him up to boast, and to abide at home rather than meddle to his hurt.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 25: Amaziah Serves the Most High With a Divided Heart

points: Amaziah would not hear, for it came of the Most High, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies because they had sought the gods of Edom. Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 25: Amaziah Serves the Most High With a Divided Heart

points: Amaziah lived fifteen years after the death of Joash king of Israel. From the time he turned away from following the Most High they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish, but they sent after him and slew him there.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 25: Amaziah Serves the Most High With a Divided Heart

points: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah. So he was sixteen years old. He was a novice.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah. Keep in mind what tribe Uzziah was. That is why I read verse one. He was Judah.

All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah. He reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem and did that which was right in the sight of the Most High.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 26: Uzziah Prospers, Then Pride Brings Him Low

points: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Amaziah did.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride
